name: Lake Materials Co., Ltd.
summary: Lake Materials Co., Ltd., established in 2010 and headquartered in Sejong City, South Korea, specializes in the creation and manufacturing of organometallic compounds. These sophisticated materials serve as crucial components in cutting-edge fields such as semiconductors, display technology, and solar energy. The company's offerings span electronic-grade materials for semiconductors, displays, and LEDs, alongside a comprehensive selection of catalysts for the petrochemical sector. Their product lineup features substances like trimethylgallium, trimethylaluminum, and trimethylindium, in addition to various fine chemical materials, metallocene catalysts, co-catalysts, and supported catalysts. The firm officially changed its name to Lake Materials Co., Ltd. in April 2013, having previously been known as Lake LED Co., Ltd.
